integrity: The closed-form theorem has a complete elementary analytical proof from the published vertex/facet model; the finite LP checker supplies corroboration and not a proof for all integer parameters. Prior research results used as prerequisites or overlapping boundary cases are credited. Historical priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Canonical incidence-vector Euclidean metric, connected minimal matroids with rank and corank at least two. This is not an affine-invariant statement or a full matroid incenter theorem. Earlier equivalent work remains possible under a pyramid-product or Chebyshev-center formulation.
title: Euclidean incenters of minimal-matroid base polytopes form rank-corank simplices
